caption: The video captures a low-angle view across calm, glassy water under a bright sun in the upper-left corner, where glare washes over backlit reeds. A clump of tall grasses occupies the left foreground, partly silhouetted, while one long bent stalk arches over the near water. Distant shoreline and low hills remain fixed beneath a blue sky holding a small cluster of white clouds near center. Cloud and sky reflections lie on the water surface, shimmering subtly as the view continues. The image is sharp before softening into a pronounced blur across the middle portion and returning to crisp detail. Throughout this change, the framing stays fixed, with sun, horizon, reeds, and arched stalk keeping the same positions relative to the edges. A small green lens-flare dot remains visible in the lower-right area, marking the persistent glare from the sun.
relations: Fixed framing keeps sun, horizon, reeds, and arched stalk at constant edge-relative positions during the focus change.
A pronounced blur softens the middle portion then recovers to crisp detail across the water and sky.
Cloud reflections on the glassy water shimmer subtly as the focus state transitions from sharp to blurred and back.
A green lens-flare dot persists in the lower-right corner, marking continuous glare from the upper-left sun.
